**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4235#issuecomment-7231148552

## Scope

- The PR adds two test fixtures, one kernel test, one STEP bench row and one decision file. It does not change product code.
- It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry code. This is not a safety-tier review.
- It does not change `crates/ui`, `build.rs`, `scripts/`, `.github/`, a `Cargo.toml` or a process file.

## What looks good

- The fixture is a real SolidCraft 0.48.1 file with a variable round. The test asserts that the `.sc` keeps a `Surface::Blend` face. This is the open "Done means" item of #2578. The synthetic test of PR #3969 did not cover it.
- The test compares the `.sc` body with its own STEP export: face count, volume (1e-9 relative), box, and the machining mesh at 0.005 mm (open sides, deviation, triangle count, volume).
- The new STEP fixture has its row in `step_agreement/rows.rs` and its `per_file!` entry.
- The STEP header has no person name, organization or local path.
- The decision file obeys the `docs/decisions/` format.
- The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #2578`. The commit subject is a conventional `test(kernel):` subject.

## Results (local, trial merge with `upstream/main` `2394b5ad1`)

The PR head already contains that `main`, so the trial merge was "Already up to date".

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 109 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (17.7 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel --tests --no-deps -- -D warnings`: clean.

### Extra suites run

The diff adds files under `testdata/models/`. These suites list or read that directory:

- `camcraft-kernel --test solidcraft_import`: 14 passed (includes `release_fixture::a_release_design_with_fillets_imports_the_body_of_its_step_export`).
- `camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: 33 passed (includes `step_filleted_block`).
- `camcraft-app --test step_nesting`: 9 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed.

The diff does not change import code. Thus the importer list (rule 2) does not apply.

## Mutations

1. Face count `8` changed to `9` in `release_fixture.rs`: the test went red (`left: 8, right: 9`).
2. The `step_filleted_block` entry removed from `step_agreement.rs`: `step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name` went red.

The tree was restored after each mutation.

## Heavy lanes

The heavy plan maps the `testdata/` change to 30 app heavy steps. This review did not run them. Each of those suites reads named fixtures, and no suite reads `filleted_block.*`. Heavy lanes are not a merge condition (#3556).

## Optional, non-blocking

- `docs/decisions/2578-sc-blend-fixture.md`: the second heading, `## The STEP bench row`, has no `#N -` prefix. `cargo xtask decisions` gathers it as a separate entry. You can make it a `###` sub-heading.

## Labels

The PR is `MERGEABLE`. This review sets `merge-ready`. The PR author is not mkinney, so the PR stays a draft. The author or the maintainer flags it ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
